profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
I have a Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science and a minor in Mathematics (graduated in December 2021).

Currently a Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (MFC). I was an intern at the same company from May 2021-Dec 2021. I was part of the College Work Experience Program (CWEP) as a Software Engineer Intern for UTA’s Lockheed Martin Career Development Center during Jan 2021-May 2021. I also worked as a Software Engineer Intern during Jan 2020-Dec 2020 for Indotronix Avani Group with the CWEP program as well. Throughout my time in the CWEP program, I worked as a contractor at the client site of Lockheed Martin MFC in Grand Prairie, TX.
